plain_conclusion: French官方规模×价值、经营盈利及动量分组可以回答一个独立且有用的买入端问题：在同一规模层内，高分组合相对三个分组平均分配是否有收益或风险帮助。它不是OSAP缺失文件的等价替代；来源与定义变更须在效果前冻结。

review_boundary.source_status: group portfolios not yet qualified; no unconditional execution approval

necessary_revisions.issue: scope.json asks beyond momentum, while method-contract compares within each original signal sort. Different source universes and weights do not identify increment beyond momentum.
necessary_revisions.action: Freeze the narrower within-sort question in scope and reporting: H versus equal-capital all-groups B for each BM/GP/Mom12m. Mom is a parallel reference, not a common-universe controlled opponent. Do not rank the three H-B values as independent factor superiority.
necessary_revisions.acceptance: Claims explicitly limited to published original-sort buy portfolios; same-stock increment deferred without adding a new experiment.

necessary_revisions.issue: Highest/lowest integer portfolios need not be the published LS buy/sell legs.
necessary_revisions.action: For each signal bind vintage, raw ranking direction, integer-group universe, portfolio weighting, formation/rebalance timing and holding-period overlapping-cohort aggregation. Resolve exact H and L group sets and weights from the official construction. If tails contain multiple groups, do not assume equal weighting or a single extreme group. Published LS sign is already oriented; never multiply it by Sign again.
necessary_revisions.acceptance: Before headline effects, freeze the mapping and an output-rounding tolerance justified by source precision. If source LS is exactly these two leg returns, reconcile H-L with LS on every common month. A discrepancy blocks the claimed LS decomposition until construction/version differences are resolved; do not choose tails by best fit. If exact LS replication is structurally unavailable, any separately defined extreme-group comparison must be explicitly refrozen before effects and cannot attribute the earlier published LS outcome.

necessary_revisions.issue: B is an artificial group allocation, contains H/L, and may overweight stocks in small groups.
necessary_revisions.action: Define B_t as the arithmetic mean of the K fixed original integer-group return series, equivalent to monthly restoration of equal group capital at the published gross-return level. It is neither the original universe market return nor necessarily equal-stock allocation. Preserve original within-group weights. Define H-B, B-L and H-L on identical dates and verify the arithmetic identity; do not present the two components as independent evidence or report percentage attribution when the denominator is small/oppositely signed.
necessary_revisions.acceptance: Report actual K and available source constituent-count coverage. Unknown holdings overlap, concentration and turnover stay unknown. B-L positive only means L lagged B, not that L lost money. No cash/execution interpretation without additional evidence.

necessary_revisions.issue: Uncertainty targets and outcome-defined conditions need exact pre-effect definitions.
necessary_revisions.action: Primary recent interval targets: mean(H-B), SD(H)-SD(B), E[H-B|B<0], and mean(B-L) for the stated decomposition question. H-L mean/identity is reported alongside. Fix sample SD convention. Resample the complete synchronized monthly group vectors with shared circular 12-month indices for 5000 draws, seed 20261020; recompute B, dispersion and conditional means within each draw. Carry original B-negative/positive labels with sampled dates, count repeated dates, leave an empty conditional draw missing. Do not first subset to negative months then draw blocks.
necessary_revisions.acceptance: All recent statistics use exactly 120 fixed common months per qualified signal, preserve zero-B months separately. Report H-B when B>0 and in the largest ceil(0.1*N) B months with date tie-break and positive-count disclosure; no need to add intervals for every descriptive metric. Include H/B/L levels, negative-month share and worst month, not just differences. Different signals have different B-defined conditions and these are not common US market regimes.

necessary_revisions.issue: Missing source groups or silent shortening could turn source availability into a selected favorable sample.
necessary_revisions.action: Validate fixed original K groups, unique month/group records, units, special missing codes, raw versus excess return convention and complete planned dates before effects. No zero filling, dropping missing groups and redistributing, or tail substitution. Existing 2015-2024 recent and 1963-2014 background periods remain fixed; recent 2015-2019 and 2020-2024 and yearly contributions are descriptive, not independent confirmation.
necessary_revisions.acceptance: If any planned signal or period lacks qualification, mark the affected comparison blocked and give exact missing support. Any partial deliverable requires an explicit source-driven amendment before outcomes, retains all three planned candidate statuses, and never claims the missing comparison was evaluated.

fairness_and_optional_context.necessary_opponents: Within each published sort H, B and L suffice for the fixed selection/decomposition question. No additional candidate, parameter scan or optimized exposure scaling is required.
fairness_and_optional_context.market_and_rf: Useful context if properly bound within existing source authorization, but not necessary for H-B/B-L. If obtained, distinguish total market return from Mkt-RF; do not subtract raw returns from an excess-return comparator. Missing market/RF prevents market-beating or financing claims, not this within-sort comparison.
fairness_and_optional_context.risk_claim_limit: A lower H volatility or better B-negative-month return is a historical relative-risk characteristic. It does not establish risk-adjusted alpha, dominance over cash scaling, or a new timing rule. Do not automatically add half-B unless the question is explicitly changed to an exposure-control policy.
fairness_and_optional_context.costs: No invented fee or turnover deduction. Positive gross buy-side differences justify a limited further feasibility question, not net implementation approval.

decision_and_stop: If H-B has no supported benefit while B-L is positive, report that this comparison locates more of the spread in avoiding the low group; it does not prove low stocks are shortable or value/profitability is universally ineffective.

If H-B shows return or risk help, retain only the corresponding use, jointly with positive-B-month opportunity cost, standalone levels and period reversals; no post-hoc pass threshold or selection-adjusted significance claim.

One fixed run is sufficient after source and definition acceptance. Do not change tails, dates, weighting or candidate list to obtain favorable results. Do not replay other owners LS/AQR/accrual studies.

Unknown portfolios or construction stop the affected source qualification. All-public already-viewed history remains exploratory, including the recent ten years; long-only source portfolios are not ETF or LEI execution evidence.

controller_action: Freeze the explicitly changed French scope, definitions, primary big-size comparison and qualified source bindings before one run. This review accepts the amended purpose and bounds, not as-yet-unseen file contents.

source_change_adjudication.authority: Controller message during this review: OSAP archive and standalone BM files returned quota text and were rejected; stop that source route. Use user-named French official 2x3 portfolios as an explicitly different source-defined question, no new effects viewed.
source_change_adjudication.review_evidence_limit: HTTP bodies and French source files were not independently read in this method review; this records design acceptance, not source receipt acceptance.
source_change_adjudication.supersedes: R2 OSAP-LS mapping applies only if reviving OSAP; for the newly proposed French comparison use the mapping below. R1/R3/R4/R5 remain applicable. Existing input bindings identify the earlier proposal; freeze and bind the amended scope/design/source files before execution.
definition_boundaries: French operating profitability is not GP/assets; bind the exact official revenue/expense/book-equity construction and availability rules. Do not call this a replication of gross profitability.
French book-to-market is not automatically OSAP tangible book equity/market equity.
Exact official momentum lookback, lag, breakpoints, eligible securities and reconstitution timing must be recorded; do not inherit OSAP Mom12m holding-period definitions.
source_change_adjudication.fixed_source_choice: Choose the official value-weighted monthly 2x3 return tables before observing effects, if available. Do not compare value/equal weighting versions to choose favorable results. Confirm whether each table is total or excess returns, exclude annual summary sections and source missing sentinels, and convert documented percent units once.
source_change_adjudication.primary_and_background: Primary: big-size H/B/L over 2015-01 through 2024-12,120 months. Earlier big-size 1963-07 through 2014-12,618 months is descriptive background. Small-size analogues are separately labelled predeclared background, not an alternative winner if big-size results disappoint.
source_change_adjudication.group_formula: Within each fixed size bucket and each signal, B=(low+neutral+high)/3 using the three published value-weighted portfolio returns and fixed equal group capital; H and L use source-verified favorable and unfavorable score categories. This does not equal the capitalization-weighted return of all stocks in that size bucket.
source_change_adjudication.published_factor_mapping: Big-size H-L is a within-big spread. Do not force it to match the published HML/RMW/Mom factor. When the exact official factor formula is one half small H-L plus one half big H-L, only that specified combination is the matching object. Verify official formula, direction, version and same-month source before using it for a reconciliation. No published-factor reconciliation is necessary if the new claim remains only within-size H-B/B-L.
source_change_adjudication.fairness_limit: Holding size bucket fixed reduces a size-mix difference, but each factor may have a different eligible stock set due to accounting fields and breakpoints. Cross-factor H-B comparisons remain parallel published-sort descriptions, not same-stock increment beyond momentum.
source_change_adjudication.practicality_limit: Big-size portfolios are a reasonable predeclared implementation-oriented reference, not evidence of personal tradability or ETF equivalence. Small-size is not synonymous with microcaps. Holdings, turnover, financing and transaction costs remain unmeasured.
source_change_adjudication.uncertainty_scope: Retain the planned primary recent big-size intervals and all three candidates. Small-size and earlier history remain descriptive; no additional search or inferential family is required.
source_change_adjudication.budget_stop: Record both failed OSAP requests in actual cumulative source use. A changed source name does not reset budget. If French files fail qualification, stop the affected comparison or explicitly amend source-driven partial reporting before effects; no third source family or broader candidate scan is implied.
